request_text: You get 2 messages to me, and anything after that is turned away. My bandmate asked me to track down a leaf spring for the rig that hauls our gear to gigs, and I agreed before looking at my hand. You get 101 steps, and every tool call burns one. A lower final total beats a higher one, every time. Anything sold out is a dead card, so every last item should be available to ship, no exceptions. All told, the whole haul gets 20000 cents in US currency, and not one cent more, no matter how nicely the cart is dressed up. Here is the hand I have been dealt: 2 tie rod ends & parts where the make is ford; 1 springs & parts where the type is leaf spring; 1 dash cam where the video resolution is 720p and the field of view is at most 160 degrees; and 1 brake rotors where the color is black and the type is bowl type or drag. The springs & parts must be compatible with my car, model TOT 6910. I am the one with the laptop, so apparently I am also the one playing her cards. The dash cams must be compatible with my car, model TOT 6910. The brake rotors must be compatible with my car, model TOT 6910.
